name: Apothecary
description: Apothecary word search puzzles gather jar and herb English for adults — tincture, mortar, shelf, chamomile, lavender and calm shop words — using common nouns only. No medical claims, no pharmacy brands and no product slogans. Free online with easy, medium, hard and large print; no timer and no account. The list smells like a quiet counter: beeswax, pestle, sachet, rosemary and ledger sit beside short words such as jar, leaf and oil. This hub sits under Herbs and pairs well with Gardening Tools, Flowers, Cooking and Coffee Tea when you want a wider kitchen-garden session. Large print suits evening reading glasses. New to word searches? Read how to play first.
